messages:
maya: Heads-up: ops-monitor reported a spike of unacknowledged pages from notify-orch around 10:02 UTC. ~23 delivery failures in 5m :rotating_light:
ops-bot: alert notify-orch.delivery.failures count=23 window=5m hosts=notify-orch-prod-0,notify-orch-prod-1
samir: any clues? pipeline looked fine earlier
oncall-eric: I never got the SMS for the active pager at 10:03 for acme-inc. Slack channel message only, no SMS/call
sre-lead-ana: pulling notify-orch logs, suspicious ack parse exceptions. grabbing sample
sre-lead-ana: log snippet:
```
ERROR ack_parser: failed to parse ack payload, reason=unicode_decode_error, payload="{\"page_id\":\"p-1234\",\"note\":\"Investigate: customer reported crash \ud83d\udc4d\"}"
```
maya: emoji in the incident note. our ack parser added last quarter assumed ascii-only JSON. unicode slipped through validation
samir: that would cause ack mismatch -> pages remain unacknowledged and escalation stalled
oncall-eric: which customers were affected? I need to start outreach
sre-lead-ana: query: 7 distinct paging events in the window. Affected: acme-inc, betabridge, coremetrics, delta-pay, edge-ops, fileflow, gldev. SMS/call fallback failed, slack got the messages
maya: mitigation options: hotfix or revert the parser change
sre-lead-ana: plan: deploy ack-parser tolerant mode (id-only fallback) + sanitize note field to strip non-ascii. will canary to notify-orch-prod
maya: do it. also enable manual on-call paging for critical customers while we hotfix
sre-lead-ana: deploying canary now:
```
# deploy canary
./deploy_release.sh --component notify-orch --image notify-orch:hotfix-emoji-20260317 --filter canary
```
sre-lead-ana: canary logs show ack_parser accepted the sample payload
```
INFO ack_parser: accepted ack, method=id_fallback, original_note_sanitized="Investigate: customer reported crash "
```
oncall-eric: I just received SMS for a test page for acme-inc at 10:27, confirmed
pagerbridge-bot: paging-delivery resumed for notify-orch; backlog processed=23; avg_delay=45s
samir: can we replay the backlog for affected customers to be safe
sre-lead-ana: replayed the 7 pages; outbound gateway accepted replays. marked manual_replay in logs for audit
maya: @oncall-eric please call delta-pay and fileflow to confirm receipt of replays
oncall-eric: delta-pay confirmed ticket created and got the page. fileflow confirmed receipt, no escalation needed
samir: root cause: ack parser assumed ASCII; unicode/emoji in note caused parse error, no fallback existed, resulting in unacknowledged pages and delayed SMS/call
maya: customer impact: 7 customers saw delayed SMS/call (3-25m). No confirmed SLO misses beyond delay. all replays accepted. we'll run a token-level audit
sre-lead-ana: short follow-ups:
- revert strict JSON ascii-only check -> implement unicode-safe parser + sanitize notes (PR opened)
- add unit tests for emoji/unicode payloads
- add telemetry for ack parse unicode failures and alert at low threshold
- update runbook: on ack error spike, trigger manual replay + targeted phone calls
maya: add console toggle to enable id-only ack parsing as fast mitigation
samir: filing post-incident ticket and notifying sales for customer comms
maya: include log snippets and deploy diff in postmortem
sre-lead-ana: will post PR link and postmortem draft by EOD
oncall-eric: thanks all :+1:
ops-bot: incident notify-orch-emoji-ack-parse-glitch resolved; runbook_step=manual_replay completed; duration=25m
maya: closing thread once postmortem is filed in JIRA
